description.en:
[Doubao Seedance 2.0 · High-Quality Video Generation]
▸ What it does: Turn a text prompt into a high-quality 3–10s video at 480p, 720p, or 1080p.
▸ Highlights: ByteDance's in-house model — rock-solid access in China, outstanding Chinese-prompt understanding, and 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 aspect ratios.
▸ Perfect for: Chinese short-video creation / Douyin & Xiaohongshu content / China e-commerce marketing / localized ads / bringing Chinese scripts to screen.
▸ Edge: China-hosted for low latency and zero cross-border network issues — plus a versatile multi-shot mode
description.zh:
【豆包 Seedance 2.0 · 高质量视频生成】
▸ 能做什么: 文字描述 → 3-10 秒高质量视频, 支持 480p / 720p / 1080p 多种分辨率
▸ 亮点: 字节自研, 国内访问稳定, 中文提示词理解优秀, 支持 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 多种比例
▸ 典型场景: 中文短视频创作 / 抖音/小红书素材 / 国内电商营销 / 本土化广告 / 中文剧本视觉化
▸ 优势: 国内部署, 低延迟 / 无跨境网络问题 / 支持 versatile 多镜头模式

versions.release_note: Seedance 2.0: 旗舰视频, 多分辨率 + 多镜头模式

description.en:
[Veo 3.1 · Top-Tier Video Generation (High Quality)]
▸ What it does: Turn a text prompt into a 4–8s cinematic video — native audio, fine-grained camera control, and physically real lighting.
▸ Highlights: Google's latest video model — reference images (subject/style), first-and-last-frame interpolation, scene extension up to 30s, and multiple aspect ratios.
▸ Perfect for: premium ad films / movie trailers / brand promos / short-drama creation / product launch videos / fine-art work.
▸ Pro features: two reference images for character consistency / precise first-and-last-frame camera control / extend duration by continuing from a source video
description.zh:
【Veo 3.1 · 顶级视频生成 (高质量)】
▸ 能做什么: 文字描述 → 4-8 秒电影级视频, 原生音频 / 精细镜头控制 / 真实物理光影
▸ 亮点: Google 最新视频模型, 支持参考图 (主体/风格) / 首末帧插值 / 场景扩展至 30s / 多种比例
▸ 典型场景: 高端广告片 / 影视预告 / 品牌宣传 / 短剧创作 / 产品发布视频 / 艺术创作
▸ 进阶能力: 2 张参考图做角色一致性 / 首末帧精确控制镜头 / 源视频续写延长时长

versions.release_note: Veo 3.1 Quality: GA 旗舰, 原生音频 + 高级参考图 + 首末帧

description.en:
[Wan 2.7 I2V · Image-to-Video]
▸ What it does: turn one or more images into video — mix first frames, last frames, clips, and driving audio.
▸ Highlights: first/last frames steer the camera, driving audio delivers precise lip-sync, and the structured media array keeps it flexible.
▸ Perfect for: bringing product photos to life / talking-character animation / scene camera moves / still-to-video.
▸ Value: cost-effective HD video creation
description.zh:
【Wan 2.7 I2V · 图生视频】
▸ 能做什么: 单张/多张图片 → 视频 (首帧/尾帧/片段/驱动音频组合)
▸ 亮点: 首尾帧控制镜头运动, 驱动音频精确对嘴型, 结构化 media 数组灵活
▸ 典型场景: 产品图活化 / 人物讲话动画 / 场景镜头运动 / 静图转视频
▸ 性价比: 高清视频创作经济实惠

description.en:
[Wan 2.7 R2V · Reference-to-Video]
▸ What it does: a prompt plus up to 5 reference images/videos becomes a brand-new video — mixing multiple subjects and source materials.
▸ Highlights: multi-subject referencing (characters + props + scenes), reference_voice for voice cloning, and consistency held across all source materials.
▸ Perfect for: character-IP videos / style transfer / remixing existing footage / branded character animation.
▸ Value: great value for multi-subject video creation
description.zh:
【Wan 2.7 R2V · 参考生视频】
▸ 能做什么: 提示词 + 最多 5 个参考图/视频 → 新视频, 支持多主体/多素材组合
▸ 亮点: 多主体参考 (人物+道具+场景), 支持 reference_voice 音色克隆, 跨素材一致性保持
▸ 典型场景: 角色 IP 视频 / 风格迁移 / 素材二创 / 品牌角色动画
▸ 性价比: 多主体视频创作高性价比

description.en:
[Wan 2.2 Animate Mix · Video Character Swap]
▸ What it does: replace the person in a source video with a character of your choice — keeping the original scene, lighting, and motion intact.
▸ Highlights: identity preservation plus motion transfer; wan-pro mode delivers film-grade face-swap quality.
▸ Perfect for: virtual presenters / KOL remixes / celebrity-endorsement videos / personalized custom content.
▸ Note: face detection is on by default (check_image=true) — supply a clear, front-facing portrait.
▸ Value: affordable video character swapping
description.zh:
【Wan 2.2 Animate Mix · 视频换人】
▸ 能做什么: 将原视频中的人物换成指定角色图, 保留原视频场景/光影/动作
▸ 亮点: 身份保持 + 动作迁移, wan-pro 模式质量媲美影视换脸
▸ 典型场景: 虚拟主播 / KOL 二创 / 明星代言视频 / 个性化定制
▸ 注意: 人脸检测默认开启 (check_image=true), 需清晰正面肖像图
▸ 性价比: 视频换人创作经济实惠
